'''2009 Bespin Regionals Devin Aue LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Devin Aue]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Devin Awe
* '''Deck name:''' Army Of Guys
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
